name: Zephyr Yield Share
oneLiner: ZYS is Zephyr Protocol's yield-share wrapper over ZSD, with its NAV moving as protocol yield accrues into the underlying ZSD yield reserve.
collateral: ZSD held in the Zephyr Protocol yield reserve; each ZYS share represents a claim on the protocol's ZSD yield reserve balance
pegMechanism: ZYS is a NAV-style yield-share token rather than a flat one-dollar stablecoin. Its share price moves against ZSD as protocol yield accrues into the ZSD yield reserve.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Zephyr's v2.0.0 release introduced the yield reserve and ZYS at hardfork block 360000. Zephyr's public scanner timestamps that activation block at 2024-10-13T11:39:13Z, establishing the wrapper implementation date.

sources.label: Zephyr Protocol v2.0.0 ZSD Yield release

oracleRisk.summary: ZYS is a share of Zephyr's ZSD yield reserve rather than a borrower debt market; it inherits the underlying ZSD reserve-pricing risk, whose production oracle provider and failure handling remain unpublished.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Zephyr documents ZYS as a share of the ZSD yield reserve that provides variable yield from ZSD holdings. ZYS holders do not open borrower positions or control collateral liquidation, so there are no ZYS-specific collateral or liquidation branches to inventory; the underlying ZSD parent carries the protocol-wide reserve and oracle risk.

oracleRisk.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed on 2026-07-15 against official Zephyr v2.3.0 source commit 67c5f53 and native-chain Explorer state. ZYS is the native Zephyr yield asset, not a production EVM token. Same-asset ZYS sends map to YIELD_TRANSFER, and the reviewed source exposes no separate address-level blacklist, holder freeze, seize, privileged burn, or current issuer transfer-control path. At height 819289, block 386f59b9b27984fc4d476d89e1142f0b3189987e2da245eace0268e5fe50cc19, the network was at HF11 and the official reserve snapshot corroborated that height. ZYS shares the historical 2025 network-wide audit/hardfork transaction restriction with ZSD; this was a consensus-wide migration rather than a current holder-targeted issuer control. No direct blacklistability established.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: ZYS is a yield-share variant over the Zephyr ZSD yield reserve. Inherits ZSD's verified no-privileged-mint profile: source code review confirmed no admin/emergency mint bypass in the Zephyr Protocol codebase.

controls.label: Zephyr ZYS share accounting
controls.capDescription: ZYS represents a claim on the ZSD yield reserve rather than an independent issuer mint path.
controls.evidence: Local metadata and official Zephyr materials describe ZYS as a NAV-style yield-share token tied to the ZSD yield reserve.

review.evidence: ZYS inherits the ZSD mint-authority profile. ZSD source review found no admin/emergency mint bypass, but the registry contains no ZYS contract or native-chain control identifier and no public interface equivalent to owner(), role-event enumeration, or proxy-slot inspection was established. That source review supports the inherited design description but does not enumerate present ZYS share or code-change authority.
unresolvedQuestions: Identify a public Zephyr native-chain ZYS issuance/control interface or source-backed release-governance record that can enumerate current share-mint and code-change authority; no tracked contract address or equivalent endpoint is available.

reserves.name: ZSD yield reserve backing ZYS shares
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Zephyr Protocol on-chain ZSD yield reserve

reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 curation
reserveReview.rationale: The reviewed Zephyr materials describe ZYS as the yield-bearing share exposure to the ZSD reserve, matching the exact 100% tracked zsd-zephyr-protocol dependency in the fixed metadata. The underlying ZSD reserve is an upstream asset composition and is not duplicated as a second ZYS reserve slice.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Zephyr Protocol documentation, yield description, and source repository
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No additional direct ZYS reserve slice is identified; underlying ZSD backing remains the upstream asset's reserve question.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: ZYS is a share claim on Zephyr's on-chain ZSD yield reserve rather than assets held by a legal custodian; the reviewed sources do not establish account segregation, insolvency treatment, or reuse terms, and the underlying ZSD backing composition is the upstream asset's reserve question.

notices.title: Native private-chain yield share
notices.message: ZYS is tracked as Zephyr's yield-share wrapper over ZSD, not as base ZSD itself. Pharos sources supply, price, and APY from Zephyr Scanner because CoinGecko and DefiLlama do not expose this wrapper.
